Team — quick planning note for the Oakmont exec dinner next Thursday (Dec 3). I pulled together an updated guest list and a proposed signing flow for NDAs. Two operational items I want confirmed by EOD Monday so we can lock vendors: 

- Guest list (attached: guest_list_v4.csv): please verify final attendees and mark VIPs.
- Signing station: propose a staffed kiosk near the entrance for on-site NDA signatures + a QR pre-sign DocuSign link for the larger group. See draft_signing_flow.pdf attached.
- Transportation: VIP pickup schedule needed (we have two VIP cars reserved; confirm pick-up times and points).
- Dietary & seating: we need dietary restrictions and any private-table requests from guests; external host (Oakmont) will confirm.

Ask: Ben, can you handle vendor scope and contract draft? Aditya, can you confirm VIP pickup windows and who accompanies each guest? Laura, can legal do a quick read of the signing flow (2-3 bullet changes max)?

I'll follow up with the external confirmation email to Oakmont and EventFlow ops once we have the guest checks.

Attachments: guest_list_v4.csv, draft_signing_flow.pdf

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Field Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference

Chloe — got it, I can take point on vendor scope and the contract draft. Quick notes: 

- I'll engage EventFlow (ops@eventflow.co) for venue floorplan, staffed signing kiosk, and coat check ops. I asked them for two staffing options (onsite vs. concierge) — will push their contract draft by Mon. Attached: vendor_contract_draft.docx (initial).
- Pre-sign via DocuSign: strongly recommend we send the DocuSign link to all confirmed attendees 48 hours before the event to reduce on-site queueing. I can manage the send list once guest list is locked.
- Signing kiosk: propose one tablet + one printed-station for quick manager countersign (we'll have legal on standby).
- Cost: rough estimate ~ $2,500 for kiosk + staffing; I'll firm up after EventFlow sends rates.

Action items I have: finalize vendor scope, push contract draft to legal (Laura), confirm escorting staff for VIP arrivals.

Attachment: vendor_contract_draft.docx
